reason: They don't name the payment company, the fee or when the money lands in my account, and those are the first three things I need to know. My guests are tourists who review me on Google and Tripadvisor, so ratings inside a new app nobody has heard of don't help me much.
objection: A fee nobody tells me 'charged on top' of my bank terminal. On my margins every tetri per transaction counts, and if the payout comes days later I can't pay my suppliers.
would_change_my_mind: Naming the bank or payment partner, with a written fee no higher than my current terminal and payout the next day, plus a way to push happy guests to leave a Google review.
